title: Bethany R NDE 6805
content: The first thing I noticed was a sense of pure calm and peace. I started to see people currently in my life and then going backwards into the past. Next thing I knew I went to a pure blackness. There was in an open amphitheater on the left and amazing gardens to the right. It wasn't what I saw though it was this indescribable by words feeling of absolute peace and comfort. I looked around. There were many, many people standing all around talking in light whispers amongst each other asking, ‘What is this? Where is this? Why are we here?’ Then I just knew this wasn't a dream nor in any way did it feel like a dream. I was in another place, another realm. I knew I was at a point of I didn't know if or how to return. I knew I wasn't alone and I was with other people who had just passed as well. It was interesting. I heard many different languages yet I understood them all. I sat in a chair because I didn't want to talk to anyone and looked out onto the beautiful gardens with colors unearthly. Tighter, more vivid and colors I've never seen before. It wasn't so much what I saw as to what I felt and I loved what I felt so much. When I found myself back in darkness I just panicked. Just this sheer ‘No, no, no, I don't want to leave here, please no!’ panic. I feared the darkness I knew I was coming back to this life. I felt so heavy. I was so upset and mad I came back. I was drenched in sweat and heard many hospital staff talking about me being in hyperthermia and my heart rate being close to two hundred. Then I just started to cry. I was so scared to be back here, felt heavy and sweaty, and be in pain with my arm, chest, and eyes. I realized I had a young child at home and it struck me that when I had died and was in that wonderful place I had no cares. I didn't care I had a child and that was so impactful to me. I knew I had died, that is the only way I'd never care I had a child.

arrival.other_being_detail: Many people standing all around talking in light whispers; experiencer believed they were with other people who had just passed as well.

environment.environment_other_detail: Open amphitheater on the left; amazing gardens to the right; unearthly, tighter/more vivid colors than ever seen before.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Experience included transitions into darkness/blackness, an amphitheater and gardens, multilingual understanding, and distress/panic upon returning to darkness and then to the body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Calm/peace → seeing people in life going backwards into the past → pure blackness → amphitheater/gardens with many people → back to darkness with panic → return to body in hospital.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Returned to darkness/blackness more than once.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Heard many different languages yet understood them all; other people were asking, 'What is this? Where is this? Why are we here?'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: ‘What is this? Where is this? Why are we here?’; ‘No, no, no, I don't want to leave here, please no!’
